compute_vote_loss: compute vote loss by matching predicted votes to ground truth votes for seed points
compute_objectness_loss: compute objectness loss for 3D detection proposals using near and far thresholds
compute_box_and_sem_cls_loss: compute 3D bounding box center, heading, size, and semantic classification losses
get_loss: get total loss combining vote, objectness, box, and semantic classification losses
nn_distance: compute nearest neighbor distances between two point sets using L1 metric
